question: When extra tied output rows hurt CS-MECH formation, how much is endpoint inference-time logit competition versus training-time denominator/representation damage?

scope.checkpoints: final official checkpoints for all four arms and four matched seed bundles

measurements: counterfactual shared-only eval identity exact+valid-EOS with rows 4096..24575 masked only during diagnostic decoding
counterfactual rescue = shared-only exact - full-vocabulary exact
teacher-forced probability mass assigned to extra rows
denominator tax in nats = logsumexp(full logits) - logsumexp(shared logits) = -log(1 - extra_probability_mass)
target-logit margin versus strongest extra-row logit
target rank under full vocabulary and shared-only vocabulary
shared-row and extra-row embedding norm summaries

material_endpoint_competition.rule: mean M2 counterfactual rescue >= 0.05 and rescue > 0 in at least 3 of 4 seed bundles
material_endpoint_competition.meaning: unused extra rows remain a material inference-time competitor at the endpoint
material_endpoint_competition.architecture_nominated_for_future_test: output gating/partition treatment at inference or a function-preserving routed output treatment; D8 remains EXPERIMENT_ONLY until separately validated

small_endpoint_competition.meaning: if the frozen S5 M2-vs-M3 contrast is material, the loss is more consistent with training-time denominator pressure/formation damage than endpoint decoding competition
small_endpoint_competition.architecture_nominated_for_future_test: retain physical V=24576 and test the simplest training-only output-space treatment; this is the path toward ADOPT-TRAINING-TREATMENT, not a vocabulary shrink

mixed.meaning: endpoint competition and training-time formation effects are not cleanly separated
mixed.architecture_nominated_for_future_test: do not change production output space; isolate tied-row geometry/scale next

claim_ceiling: Mechanism-localization diagnostic on development data only. It cannot alter the frozen S5 verdict, cannot authorize a production vocabulary/tokenizer change, scale run, cognition claim, or AGI claim.
